metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow popped 1 soul? Valorant aim is cursed again
metadata.description:
Me: wildly clicking like I’m swatting air
Enemy: probably questioning existence
How did that even hit? No clue, but I’ll take the freebie
If your aim’s a beautiful disaster, this one’s for you

Tap if you’ve ever landed a kill you didn’t deserve!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
